covers: The US session after the October CPI report, the JSE close and the rand, Tuesday 10 November 2026
headline: Nvidia falls 5.8% as the US 10-year yield touches 5%; gold slips to $4,032.70 and the rand weakens to R16.59/$
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 114,693.44 and the Top 40 at 106,738.05, but gold miners fell, with Harmony down 5.3% and Gold Fields down 4.4%, and the rand weakened to R16.59/$ (LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 18:39 SAST). In New York the S&P 500 was at 7,492.45 and the Nasdaq at 24,978.56 at 18:39 SAST, with the US 10-year Treasury yield at 5.0% after October consumer prices rose more than expected; Nvidia fell 5.8% while AMD rose 1.9%. Gold eased to $4,032.70 and platinum to $1,536.50 while Brent rose to $91.80; US yields at 5% remain the main pressure on the rand, gold and emerging-market shares.

items.title: Nvidia down 5.8% at $168.29 as CEO scandal weighs, while other chip stocks rise
items.summary: Nvidia traded at $168.29, down 5.8%, at 18:39 SAST, while AMD was up 1.9%. CNBC headlines today link the pressure to questions over CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy and say it complicates Nvidia's China business. Nvidia reports results on 17 November.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST; CNBC headline, 10 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year Treasury yield back at 5.0%
items.summary: The benchmark yield reached 5.0% (4.86% on Monday). A CNBC headline attributes the move to the hot October inflation data and comments from Fed Governor Waller that raised expectations of a rate hike.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST; CNBC headline, 10 Nov 2026

items.title: S&P 500 7,492.45, Nasdaq 24,978.56 after the inflation surprise
items.summary: At 18:39 SAST the S&P 500 was at 7,492.45 and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,978.56, close to the levels an hour earlier (7,483.24 and 24,996.37 at 17:51 SAST) and still below Monday's close. October consumer prices rose 0.4%, more than expected (CNBC, 10 Nov).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST; CNBC, 10 Nov 2026

items.title: Dell down 4.2%; Intuit and Meta little changed
items.summary: Among other names we follow at 18:39 SAST: Dell $331.67 (-4.2%), Deckers $88.66 (-2.0%), Intuit $338.43 (+0.1%), Meta $642.37 (+0.2%).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST

items.title: JSE All Share closes at 114,693.44; gold miners slide
items.summary: The All Share closed at 114,693.44 and the Top 40 at 106,738.05. Gold shares fell with the gold price: Harmony R272.08 (-5.3%), Gold Fields R638.63 (-4.4%), AngloGold Ashanti R1,570.50 (-2.0%), while Naspers rose 1.4% to R778.00.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Manufacturing output falls 3.5% year on year in September
items.summary: Stats SA's September manufacturing production was down 3.5% from a year earlier, a smaller fall than the 4.3% decline in August. Factory output has now contracted for a second month, alongside weak mining data.

items.title: Unemployment rises to 33.7% in Q3 2026, from 33.6% in Q2
items.summary: Stats SA's Quarterly Labour Force Survey released this morning.

items.title: Rand R16.59/$, R18.48/€, R22.09/£
items.summary: The rand weakened further against the dollar (R16.54/$ at 17:51 SAST, R16.37/$ at 11:41 SAST) as US yields rose, while staying steady against the euro and pound.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST

items.title: Gold $4,032.70, platinum $1,536.50, Brent $91.80, copper about $13,768/t
items.summary: Gold slipped further from $4,057.40 an hour earlier as yields rose. Brent firmed from $90.53 at 17:51 SAST.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST

items.title: Nvidia: shares at $168.29, further below our $262.56 fair value
items.summary: Today's 5.8% fall is driven by the CEO controversy rather than a change in the business we can verify; results on 17 November are the next test. Our BUY rating is unchanged.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 18:39 SAST; LRC Watchlist
